KPI: Average Selling Price by best selling product
Description: Average price paid per unit for a product Used to analyze price dynamics of best-selling products
Sales trend over time for each state
Formula: SUM(Sales) by Order Date and State

Description: Customer generating the highest sales within a customer segment
Formula: Customer with MAX(SUM(Sales)) within each Segment

Description: Total sales generated by each product within each state, used to identify top and bottom products by sales

KPI: Top/Bottom Product by Delivery Time by state
Description: Product with the highest or lowest average delivery time within each state
Formula: Product with MAX/MIN(AVG(Ship Date - Order Date)) within each State
Granularity: Product, State,  Month(Order Date),  Month(Ship Date)
